learnedHeuristics.directive: Every production code modification MUST be paired with at least one deterministic unit or regression test file in targetFiles and fileMutations.
learnedHeuristics.sourceReason: Baseline Hub Invariant — Stage 6 Auditor requires verified unit test coverage.

learnedHeuristics.directive: Propagate CancellationToken through all async methods, enforce ConfigureAwait(false) in library/infrastructure code, and apply AsNoTracking() on read-only EF Core queries.
learnedHeuristics.sourceReason: Microsoft Learn .NET 8 Concurrency & EF Core Performance Standards.

learnedHeuristics.directive: Use constructor injection, @Transactional(readOnly = true) for query methods, Jakarta Bean Validation annotations on request DTOs, and AssertJ in JUnit 5 tests.
learnedHeuristics.sourceReason: Official Spring Boot 3 & Jakarta EE Specifications.

learnedHeuristics.directive: Enforce non-root container execution (securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true), explicit CPU/memory requests and limits, valid Grafana/OpenTelemetry JSON schemas, and bash -n syntax verification.
learnedHeuristics.sourceReason: CNCF, CIS Kubernetes Benchmark & OWASP Container Security Guidelines.

forbiddenAntiPatterns.patternDescription: Emitting lazy truncation placeholders such as '// ... existing code ...' or '/* remaining implementation */' in Stage 4 FileMutation.updatedContent.
forbiddenAntiPatterns.mitigationRule: Always emit 100% complete, compilable source files in FileMutation.updatedContent without any omitted sections.

forbiddenAntiPatterns.patternDescription: Citing unofficial blogs (Medium, Reddit, StackOverflow, dev.to, Baeldung, DZone) as Stage 2 EvidenceBlocks.
forbiddenAntiPatterns.mitigationRule: Cite only official standards bodies and documentation (Microsoft Learn, IETF RFCs, ECMA, OWASP, CNCF, Official Spring/Python/Node Docs, WHO/AAP/PCI-DSS).
